description: Show one survey of the company: title, status (draft, active, closed, archived), start and end date, participant limit, anonymity threshold, the participation link for employees and the edit link for the account owner. Read-only. Use it to check a single survey or fetch its links; for an overview of all surveys use safe_mind_list_surveys, for results use safe_mind_get_analytics. Returns a not-found error for ids that do not exist or belong to another company. Requires an API key: set SAFE_MIND_API_KEY or call safe_mind_get_api_key first. Acts on the company of the account behind the key.

surveyId.description: Survey id (UUID) as returned by safe_mind_list_surveys or safe_mind_create_survey.

name: safe_mind_get_survey
